summary: The solution properly splits the data, applies feature engineering, and uses a multi-model ensemble. However, it suffers from a critical target leakage flaw by applying target encoding in-sample without out-of-fold generation, which will cause catastrophic overfitting. Additionally, the ensembling is naive (an unoptimized 50/50 average) and the stochastic models are only evaluated once.
